text: Phase 2 — custom RL env (no Gymnasium) + reward + actions + centrality scheduler (brief §2.2)

Phase 2 implementation bundle:
- src/env/state.py — State dataclass (A, X∈ℝ^|V|×16) per STATE_DESIGN
- src/env/actions.py — Action space (split/merge/rewire/noop), A_max=45057
- src/env/action_mask.py — pre-softmax mask (Huang & Ontañón 2022)
- src/env/reward.py — canonical R_t = α·ΔMod + β·ΔCoh − γ·Coupling + P_skills
- src/env/skills_graph_env.py — custom training loop, NO Gymnasium (brief §2.2 ban)
- src/services/centrality.py + CentralityScheduler — Degree per-step, Betweenness EXACTLY 2/seed
- scripts/run_episode_smoke.py — end-to-end episode roll
- tests for every module
- flip tests/architecture/test_env_no_gym.py from xfail to active (now PASSES)
- flip tests/architecture/test_betweenness_call_count.py from xfail to active (now PASSES)
- flip tests/architecture/test_reward_formula.py from xfail to active (now PASSES)

Pipeline smoke: env.reset() → 28-step random masked-uniform episode →
final_betweenness call 2/2 → episode_length=28, total_reward=0.000000,
betweenness_calls=2, final |V|=30.

Note: src/services/metrics/ (modularity, cohesion, coupling) deferred to
Phase 3; reward.py late-imports them and env wraps in _safe_reward so the
plumbing exercises end-to-end today (returns 0.0 until metrics land).

Gates: ruff clean, ruff format clean, all .py ≤ 150 LOC, coverage 95.27%
(≥85% gate), 141 passed / 1 skipped, no Gymnasium imports anywhere in
src/env or src/services.

Phase 2 fix — wire metrics services (close Codex gap, env reward becomes real)

The 12-agent Phase 2 workflow's 3 Codex agents (modularity, cohesion,
coupling) couldn't produce files because the Codex companion was
unavailable. env._safe_reward caught the ModuleNotFoundError and
returned total_reward=0.0 in the smoke pipeline.

This commit lands the 3 metrics services Claude-default:

- src/services/metrics/__init__.py — re-exports
- src/services/metrics/modularity.py — Newman-Girvan Q via Louvain
- src/services/metrics/cohesion.py — size-weighted within-community clustering
- src/services/metrics/coupling.py — fraction of cross-community edges
- tests for each module (>=85% coverage)
- env+reward wiring confirmed: compute_reward now returns non-zero RewardComponents

Smoke pipeline now produces a real reward signal once apply_action mutates the graph (Phase 3+ work). The defensive _safe_reward fallback is kept as a future-proofing catch.
